## Orientation

Concurrent with exec-dispatch. You own skills/plan-phase/SKILL.md, contract/project-design.json, skills/kinds-and-focus.md, README.md, and tests/test_plan_wave_rules.py. Do not edit skills/execute-phase/SKILL.md or tests/test_execute_wave_dispatch.py.

A field in a record's payload array is required on every record unless it is also listed in optional_payload. optional_payload entries must also appear in payload. The live store already has work-items with no executor. Do not run adaptive-artifacts. Do not edit .artifacts.
